toplevel: Two heading sections only; no text outside them.

units.key: § Working in this repository > The code map is part of every change
units.does: States that docs/codemap/records holds a record per unit, that a call graph is built from the records and the code, and that CI (gates.yml, ci.yml, make ci) and the pre-commit hook fail while any record is missing or older than its code, and list the records older than a change in what one of their callees does. Says findings (flags) and the open-findings budgets live in the local, untracked overlay do_not_ship/codemap/ (flags/<path>.json, codemap_open_high.txt, codemap_open_med.txt), that codemap.py merges it when present and writes flags only there, and that the ratchet runs only where the overlay exists (pre-commit hook, local make ci). Before a change: run codemap.py impact <path::key> (or make codemap-impact) and read the record, callers, triggers, tests, shared state and, with the overlay, open findings. During: make codemap-guard; sync for added/removed units; rewrite each listed record against the code (with the overlay, removing fixed flags and adding found problems; public records describe behaviour only); re-read each re-check caller the change adds (codemap.py status lists them) against its callee's new behaviour and fix the caller or its record; then stamp, callees before callers; guard clean before committing. High- and medium-severity findings only go down: a fix deletes the flag and lowers the overlay's codemap_open_high.txt or codemap_open_med.txt; a new one is fixed, not recorded. Forbids stamping a record or a re-check that was not re-read, and rewording a record whose behaviour did not change (it sends every caller back). Points to docs/codemap/README.md for the full procedure. Every command named exists.
